Subject: BrightHealth reference interview: scheduling, agenda, and recording consent

Hi Miranda,

Thanks again for agreeing to speak with us for a customer reference/case study. We want to keep this light — a 25–30 minute recorded conversation to cover how BrightHealth is using Redwood Inference, the results you've seen, and any advice for teams evaluating inference platforms.

Draft agenda (attached):
- 5m quick intros + context
- 10m technical/operational: architecture, integrations, performance wins
- 8m business impact: metrics, cost, time-to-market examples
- 5m wrap & quotes / next steps

Would you be able to confirm:
1) Which stakeholders should join (we typically include a product and an engineering lead)
2) Whether BrightHealth is comfortable with us recording the call for drafting the case study and pulling a brief quote (we’ll share quotes for approval before publication)
3) A few 30-min windows that work next week (we're flexible)

Attached: proposed_agenda.md, case_study_consent.pdf (consent form + quote approval process). If you prefer, we can also provide questions in advance.

Proposed times (PST): Wed 6/2 10:00–10:30, Thu 6/3 09:00–09:30, Thu 6/3 14:00–14:30. Let me know what works or share a calendar link and I’ll send an invite.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
